assertions.assertion: Blue Summit Plan denied the claim
The service denied was cardiac event monitoring
The denial was issued under reason code PR-204
PR-204 indicates the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's condition
The patient has a history of intermittent palpitations
The patient has subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The symptoms prompted further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia
The clinical presentation is consistent with diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances
The study captures electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
A written appeal is being submitted
The appeal details the clinical necessity of CPT 93271
The appeal requests reconsideration of the PR-204 determination
